summary: FRONTEND-ONLY test of v10.2.16 AI Suggestions STUCK fix (api.ts AbortController timeout + AISuggestionsSheet load_failed state). ALL 3 TARGET FLOWS PASS. (1) NORMAL FLOW: sheet opens from Trader Profile modal and reaches terminal state in ~3s (LOCKED_PREMIUM for non-premium browser device — valid outcome), category chips (Crypto/IDX/World Stocks/Gold/Forex...) all visible, only expected console error is the 403 premium gate. (2) STUCK FIX: intercepted '**/api/ai-suggestions*' to HANG forever — skeleton showed, then at EXACTLY ~45s the AbortController fired and the dedicated ⚠️ 'Failed to load signals / Slow connection or the server is busy...' error state rendered with the gold RETRY button (testID ai-retry). NO infinite skeleton, NO misleading 'Belum ada setup' empty state. (3) RETRY: after un-intercepting, tapping ai-retry re-fetched and reached LOCKED_PREMIUM terminal state within ~3s. REGRESSION: dashboard loads fine, disclaimer checkbox+I Agree flow fine, no panic text.
critical_code_review_comments: api.ts get() timeout implementation is correct: AbortController only created when timeoutMs provided, timer cleared in finally, abort mapped to descriptive 'Timeout 45000ms on <path>' error — no regression risk to other endpoints (only aiSuggestions passes 45_000).
AISuggestionsSheet render ordering is correct: premium_required (locked) > loading (skeleton) > load_failed (⚠️+retry) > empty > list; load_failed can no longer fall through to the empty state.
i18n keys ai_load_failed_title/ai_load_failed_sub exist for id/en/ru/cn and the retry button reuses the existing 'retry' key.
seed_data_creation: None. Non-premium browser device (localStorage cryptostock.device_fingerprint) used as-is; LOCKED_PREMIUM is the expected terminal state for this device.
context_for_next_testing_agent: v10.2.16 stuck-fix verified end-to-end on preview: 45s AbortController timeout fires precisely and load_failed UX (⚠️ + gold ai-retry) works; retry recovers to a valid terminal state. Note: in web preview the browser device_id is NOT premium, so /api/ai-suggestions returns 403 → LOCKED_PREMIUM blur state; to see the real suggestions list in preview you must login with an unlock code bound to the browser device (see /app/memory/test_credentials.md) or test with premium device_id test-judge-device-001 via direct API.
rca_of_issue: Original bug: api.ts get() had no timeout so a hanging fetch left the skeleton forever, and error 'load_failed' was never rendered (fell through to empty state). Verified fixed: timeout fires at 45s -> error state renders; HTTP error path also covered by same state. No residual issue found.
